summary: PMGC Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary, NorthStrive Defense Tech LLC, entered into a binding term sheet with Florida State University Research Foundation to license patent rights for aerospace and defense technologies. The license is exclusive, worldwide, and sublicensable, with tiered earned royalties on net sales, annual minimum royalty, sublicensing revenue share, and a license maintenance fee. NorthStrive also signed a research agreement funding $490,657 for related research. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is present.
